privacy.title: Política de privacidad

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.intro: We collect information that you provide directly to us when you:
items: Submit a contact form or project inquiry
Communicate with us via email, phone, or social media

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Respond to your inquiries and provide customer support

sections.title: 3. Information Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only with your consent, to comply with legal requirements, or with service providers who assist in our operations.

sections.title: 4. Data Security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve your browsing experience and analyze website traffic. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
items: Object to processing of your data

sections.title: 7. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

terms.metaDescription: Términos y condiciones de la agencia digital WEB LAUNCH
terms.title: Términos y condiciones

sections.title: 1. Agreement to Terms
sections.body: By accessing and using WEB LAUNCH services, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our services.

sections.title: 2. Services
sections.body: WEB LAUNCH provides digital agency services including website development, branding, SEO, social media, and digital marketing. Service specifications, deliverables, and timelines will be agreed upon in a separate service agreement.

sections.title: 3. Client Responsibilities
sections.body: Clients are responsible for providing accurate information, required content, timely feedback, and any credentials needed to deliver the agreed services.

sections.title: 4. Payments
sections.body: Payment terms are defined in each project agreement. Work may pause if invoices remain unpaid beyond the agreed terms.

sections.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sections.body: Upon full payment, agreed deliverables are transferred to the client as specified in the service agreement. WEB LAUNCH retains the right to showcase non-confidential work in its portfolio unless otherwise agreed.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: WEB LAUNCH is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from the use of our services, except where required by applicable law.

sections.title: 7. Contact
sections.body: For questions about these Terms, contact WEB LAUNCH at weblaunchdigital@gmail.com or +383 45 949 507.
